title: Common providers: Indonesia
coverage: Partial. Covers the national carrier, the mobile network operators, the main cable and fibre providers, three business and wholesale networks and the research network.
missing: Regional ISPs (the provider association counts many hundreds of members)
The regulator's operator register (the ministry's site refused an automated check on the read date)
Smaller business ISPs and network access providers
Websites for First Media and PLN Icon Plus (none answered an automated check on the read date)
Status pages (none was found that answered a check)

sources.name: Komdigi (Ministry of Communication and Digital Affairs)
sources.terms: The site refused an automated check on the read date, so its terms were not read and nothing is taken.
sources.result: Did not answer (HTTP 403). It is the authority to consult for operators this pack lacks.

sources.name: APJII (the Indonesian internet service provider association)
sources.terms: No terms or reuse licence were found on the page on the read date, so nothing is copied.
sources.result: The page answered on the read date. Its member list is the place to look for a regional ISP.

sources.name: Wikipedia: Internet in Indonesia
sources.terms: CC BY-SA 4.0. Used to cross-check names and ownership (facts); no text is copied.
sources.result: 1 of 13 names were found on the page.

sources.name: Each provider's own public website
sources.terms: Only the address itself is recorded (a fact); no content is copied.
sources.result: 11 of 13 websites and 3 business, support or status pages answered an automated check; an address that did not answer is left empty.

sources.name: RIPEstat as-overview (RIPE NCC)
sources.terms: The RIPEstat service terms were read on the read date; RIPEstat data is not redistributed: nothing is copied. Consulted to confirm, for each AS number, the registered holder and that the number is announced.
sources.result: 23 AS numbers confirmed; a number whose registered holder was another company, or that was not announced on the read date, was left out.

sources.name: NRO delegated statistics (the regional registries' joint list of assigned AS numbers)
sources.terms: Published by the registries for public use; only which registry holds each AS number is taken (a fact).
sources.result: Every AS number in the pack was found in the list; its registry is recorded beside it.

sources.name: PeeringDB
sources.terms: The acceptable use policy forbids reproducing PeeringDB data outside approved operational purposes: nothing is copied; cited as a place to look up an AS number.

providers.name: Telkom Indonesia
providers.notes: Its home broadband name IndiHome is run by Telkomsel.

providers.name: Telkomsel
providers.notes: Mobile, and IndiHome home broadband. The support address is the IndiHome page.

providers.name: Indosat Ooredoo Hutchison
providers.notes: AS45727 is the former Tri (3) network.

providers.name: XLSMART
providers.notes: The merged XL Axiata and Smartfren; the numbers are still registered under those names (AS133798 to Smartfren). The second address is XL's.

providers.name: First Media
providers.notes: The trading name of Link Net. Its websites did not answer or refused an automated check on the read date.

providers.name: MyRepublic Indonesia
providers.notes: Trades as MyRepublic; the Singapore provider of that name is registered as another company.

providers.name: PLN Icon Plus
providers.notes: Its websites did not answer an automated check on the read date.

providers.name: Moratelindo
providers.notes: Backbone and wholesale; Oxygen.id is its retail name (the second address).
